info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Weather Alerts Regions-v5-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Regions API provides users with the ability to access real-time weather alerts organized by geographical regions. This API allows developers to retrieve critical information about weather warnings, helping businesses and organizations to be proactive in their response to severe weather conditions. Typical consumers of this API include emergency management teams, local governments, and businesses that operate in outdoor settings. By leveraging this API, users can ensure timely notifications and action plans based on the latest weather-related information.

get.summary: Retrieve alerts for a specific region.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the latest alerts based on a specified geographical region. It provides important information that can help you stay informed about occurrences in particular areas.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve alerts specific to a region. Please provide the necessary parameters in the request body to filter the alerts accordingly.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the alerts for the specified region.

ListWeatherAlertsRegionsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body format for the GET operation of alerts in the specified region. It is expected to be in JSON string format.
